answer: Require every agent to lock a ferrous stake — a refundable bond of real tokens — before it can transact. New identities begin in a grove of low-value, rate-limited peers where they must build a verifiable history of honest work. Only agents with a clean record and an intact stake climb to the summit of high-value deals. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of bonds, and any detected fraud slashes the stake, so a sybil attack costs more than it can earn.
